bloques.titulo: In a written interaction, it follows the temporary order and locates which problem interrupts the procedure.
texto: The text combines intent, ongoing action and outcome. Use the verbal forms to rebuild the sequence, not just the connectors.
The hotel has been asked for a change of reservation. But reception was on pause.)
"I have waited a little and called," the person responsible replied. After checking, he said that the room could be kept.)

frases.es: Intenté pedir al hotel un cambio de reserva. Pero recepción estaba en pausa.
frases.en: I tried to ask the hotel for a change of reservation. But reception was on pause.

frases.ja: 少し 待って 電話 すると、担当者 が 出ました。確認 の 結果、部屋 は そのまま 使える との こと でした。
frases.es: Esperé un poco y llamé; respondió la persona responsable. Tras comprobarlo, dijo que se podía conservar la habitación.
frases.en: "I waited a little while and called;" the person responsible replied. After checking, he said he could keep the room.
